name: ai-consent
title: Consent before a third-party AI
summary: A versioned, per-account permission asked before anything is sent to a third-party AI (App Store 5.1.2(i)), single-flight so concurrent sends share one sheet, withdrawable in Account (5.1.1(ii)).
when: Personal data — messages, photos, files — reaches an AI provider outside the app's own backend.
screens: | — | AI consent | sheet | first send to the AI | — | allow / not now | — | account |
dataInventory: | What the user sends to the AI (questions, attachments) | each send, after consent | backend | `<AI provider>` | generate the answer | `<provider's retention>` | `<yes/no>` |
claudeRules: Every path that sends user content to the AI waits on `slots.withConsent(user.id, send)` first — the composer, retries, voice, suggested prompts. When what is sent changes, update `src/modules/ai-consent/disclosure.ts`, raise `CONSENT_VERSION`, and update the privacy policy and both stores' privacy forms.
